purpose: リィカの段階別の構え・攻撃ポーズを確認するラフ。ゲームへの差し替えは行っていない。

sheets.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: game animation preproduction ROUGH POSE EXPLORATION SHEET, not finished game sprites.
Input image 1 is the exact character and ordinary shovel design reference, not a composition to copy. Redraw her in the requested distinct action poses.
Character invariants: Rica, a petite ADULT elf gravekeeper woman, silver-white short hair with the same single braid over chest, long pointed ears, charcoal hooded cape worn down, dark teal long dress, weathered tan apron with waist belt and keys, brown gloves and short brown boots. Same proportions, recognizable face, same modest medieval work clothes in every pose. No redesign of costume, no helmet, no armor, no futuristic parts. Cloak and apron flow with the action.
CRITICAL WEAPON CONSTRUCTION: every figure has ONE AND THE SAME intact long wooden-shaft grave-digging SHOVEL from reference, its small D grip and worn steel pointed spade remain readable. In powered poses, translucent spectral energy is FORMED AROUND AND EXTENDS FROM THIS EXISTING STEEL SPADE. The actual brown wood shaft and dark steel spade must be drawn as clearly visible solid physical objects INSIDE the ghost weapon. This is a shovel coated in an energy weapon, never a replacement sword, never a separate sword held beside a shovel, never a floating weapon. Hands grip the physical wooden shaft at anatomically convincing positions. Energy blade must track the physical spade, no disconnect or misaligned endpoints. Preserve long physical shaft as the core.
Visual style: confident but intentionally rough graphite/ink construction drawing, loose exploratory pencil lines, mostly flat muted costume-color washes, selective colored spectral energy, strong legible silhouette. Pale warm-gray sketchbook background with lots of breathing room. Not painterly splash art, not a polished illustration. Full body and the ENTIRE extended weapon are visible in every pose, no cropped hands/feet/weapon tips. Consistent three-quarter right-facing battle view with slight depth, no enemies or scenery. Energy is semi-transparent with restrained glow so the underlying shovel is visible. Keep the character face and hands readable. Multiple drawings are the SAME character in sequential key poses. Elegant action anatomy with two arms, two hands, two legs. Clearly separate the poses, no overlapping panels.
Add a small WEAPON DETAIL inset showing the wooden shaft + physical steel spade and the exact translucent energy shape built over it; thin callout lines may point to the physical core. Minimal legible headings and numbered pose captions only. No long paragraphs, watermark or logos.

Sheet 1 of 4: "0–2層 / シャベル打撃". Wide landscape sheet with three large full-body poses in a left-to-right sequence, a small ordinary shovel detail in the bottom margin. There is ABSOLUTELY NO magical energy anywhere on this sheet.
Pose 1 caption "構え": both hands widely spaced on bare wooden shaft, knees flexed, feet planted, plain metal shovel held obliquely in front in a practical guard.
Pose 2 caption "打撃": decisive short forward step toward the right and forceful TWO-HANDED BLUNT SHOVEL STRIKE, the FLAT METAL SPADE FACE is the striking part, physical shaft swept diagonally across her body, shoulders and waist clearly rotate. Show a few short dry pencil motion marks, no magic trails, no sword-like blade. This must be a genuinely different dynamic pose from the guard.
Pose 3 caption "振り抜き": weight over front foot, ordinary shovel swung through and held low to her right, cape follows; grounded work-tool weight and believable physical follow-through.
Weapon inset: the bare physical shovel matching input. Grounded and direct rather than acrobatic. Small title, figures dominate.

Sheet 2 of 4: "3–5層 / 霊刃の横薙ぎ". Wide landscape sheet with three large full-body sequential poses and a small weapon detail inset at bottom. Energy palette exclusively pale icy blue-white.

Pose 3 caption "二撃目・返し斬り": she pivots smoothly and takes a distinct lateral follow-up step, returning the blade in the OPPOSITE downward diagonal direction, cape makes a graceful S-curve. Clearly different limb arrangement and weapon direction from pose 2, no repetition of same stance. Controlled weight, stylish connected two-hit action.
Inset: enlarged energy greatsword around the physical shovel with a visibly dark solid spade inside the translucent broad blade and a long exposed brown wooden shaft. Illustrate the connection explicitly. This sheet is about a clear GREATSWORD silhouette and fluid two-hit choreography.

All THREE poses must wield the exact same BIG, BROAD, CLEARLY DEFINED SEMITRANSPARENT STRAIGHT GREATSWORD shown in the inset, built around the original shovel. Blade length measured from the physical spade socket to the ghost tip is roughly the character's FULL STANDING BODY HEIGHT, blade width roughly her torso width. Distinct long broad greatsword with two straight edges and a pointed tip, not a lance, not a flame/aura smear. The original dark worn steel spade must remain visible INSIDE the lower part of the large ghost blade and the long wood shaft / D grip remain visible in her two hands. Exact same physical shovel throughout, NO separate sword and no crossguard or new sword hilt. Limit glow, emphasize transparent violet-blue SOLID-LOOKING FLAT BLADE PLANES and edge contour, not just thin trails.
Recompose into a spacious SQUARE 2x2 concept sheet so the large blades are never cropped: upper left "1 構え", upper right "2 一撃目・斬り上げ", lower left "3 二撃目・返し斬り", lower right "武器詳細". Draw three clear full-body poses matching the supplied action intent, retain grounded two-handed guard, ascending diagonal cut, opposite descending return cut. Entire blades, boots and hands visible in each. In guard, hold huge blade obliquely in a low loaded stance with long point clearly extending away from body. Rising cut points up-right, return cut points down-right. Diagram lower right shows intact shovel INSIDE translucent broad elongated energy blade, with minimal wood/steel/energy callouts.
Keep Rica's identity, clothes, age, apron, cloak and braid identical to references. Preserve expressive pencil outlines and loose flat-color ROUGH study style and warm-gray paper. Use restrained blue-violet effects. Sheet title exactly "6–8層 / 大剣の二連撃". The long broad BLADE SILHOUETTE IN THE MAIN POSES is the correction; it must be unmistakably a greatsword, much bigger than the physical spade.
